Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.paymentrequest

Record Class KfePaymentRequestResponse

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.paymentrequest.KfePaymentRequestResponse
Record Components:
id - internal payment-request identifier
publicId - shareable identifier safe to expose to a payer
userId - owner of the payment request
walletId - wallet credited when the request is paid
addressId - generated on-chain address record, when applicable
address - legacy primary receiving payload, such as an address or Lightning hash URI
paymentRequest - BOLT11 invoice when Lightning is the primary receiving rail
paymentHash - Lightning invoice payment hash, when available
rail - legacy primary rail designation
rails - active rail-specific receiving instructions
status - payment request lifecycle state
amountSats - fixed requested amount, or null for an open-amount request
description - user-facing request description
memo - optional payer or merchant memo
payerHint - optional hint shown to the payer
paidTransactionId - transaction that first satisfied the request
settlementTransactionId - transaction currently representing settlement
settlementStatus - lifecycle state of the settlement transaction
blockchainTxid - on-chain transaction identifier when paid on chain
confirmations - observed confirmations for the on-chain payment
grossAmountSats - amount received before downstream fees
receiverAmountSats - amount credited to the receiver
expiresAt - request expiration instant
createdAt - request creation instant
updatedAt - last update instant
behaviorContract - versioned payment behavior contract captured at creation
partialPaymentReceived - cumulative received amount for an open-amount request
webhookUrl - optional configured callback URL for payment events
public record KfePaymentRequestResponse(UUID id, String publicId, Long userId, UUID walletId, UUID addressId, String address, String paymentRequest, String paymentHash, KfeRail rail, List<RailDetail> rails, KfePaymentRequestStatus status, Long amountSats, String description, String memo, String payerHint, UUID paidTransactionId, UUID settlementTransactionId, KfeTransactionStatus settlementStatus, String blockchainTxid, Integer confirmations, Long grossAmountSats, Long receiverAmountSats, Instant expiresAt, Instant createdAt, Instant updatedAt, String behaviorContract, Long partialPaymentReceived, String webhookUrl) extends Record
API projection of a payment request, including receiving instructions and settlement progress. The compact constructor defensively copies the active rail details so callers cannot mutate the response afterward.
